index.html.title: Business Tax Planning for Owners | AE Tax Advisors
index.html.description: Explore business-owner tax planning resources, compare advisory scope and fees, and prepare the records for an AE Tax Advisors discovery call.
index.html.heading: Choose business tax support by scope and implementation
index.html.body:
Use these guides to organize your questions, then compare business-owner tax advisory with published fees and engagement scope. Confirm whether projections, implementation and return preparation are included in your written engagement.

Bring current financials, an entity list, owner compensation and the next decision deadline. Discuss your business tax planning needs with the team before committing to a strategy.
